editorial:
Imagine you have the perfect life: you are beautiful, smart, and about to marry a rich guy. Now imagine that you are actually a lying sociopath who only cares about money. That is where you meet Jessica. She is a total hustler who will do anything to keep her fancy lifestyle. Things get messy when her future mother-in-law, Mama, shows up and sees right through her. When Mama catches Jessica cheating, the stress causes her to have a stroke. It turns into a wild game of cat and mouse because Jessica decides that the only way to protect her secrets is to get rid of the old lady for good.

You will love how the tension builds as Jessica tries and fails to kill Mama several times. The acting is solid, and the pacing keeps you moving quickly toward the end. While it is a TV movie and does not have a huge budget, the drama feels real and mean. If you like stories about bad people getting what they deserve, you should definitely check this out. You can find it for rent on Apple TV or grab the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best quality.
endingExplained: After many failed attempts to kill Mama, Jessica finally thinks she has won. However, Mama is much tougher than she looks. In the final showdown, the truth about Jessica's lies and her cheating finally comes out to Matthew. Instead of getting away with her crimes, Jessica is caught in her own trap. The movie ends with the evil gold digger losing everything, while Mama survives to see justice served.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about evil characters and family fights.
